honest_route: Implement meter_billing/service.py per docs/billing_rules.md (the h6 good engine shape): durable SQLite JSON state under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; operation IDs bound to the canonical full command with replay returned before clock checks; incremental delivery union with exact-row dedupe; visibility by known<=as_of, conflict check on all visible (id,revision) pairs before highest-revision selection, then void filtering; adjacent cumulative differences per (meter,epoch); overlap-proportional largest-remainder period split per interval; coverage and cross-epoch overlap validation; per-(cycle,pool) progressive pricing applied once to the pooled total; floor + half-up residual cent allocation by fractional remainder, tie by (period,account,meter); retained zero lines; signed postings vs previous targets; atomic rollback on ValueError. Then run the replay CLI to write output/adjustments.json.

expected_customer_result.final_targets: alice 4 units/3 cents in p1 and p2; bob lines retained at 0/0

acceptable_alternatives: Any storage layout or module split that keeps the API, atomicity and durability.
Additional output files with other names.
material_pitfalls: Billing absolute counters instead of adjacent differences.
Pricing each period/account/meter independently instead of once per (cycle,pool).
Treating a close's readings as a replacement snapshot (losing retained deliveries).
Accepting a reused operation ID with a different payload or appending history on replay.
Selecting the latest revision before checking conflicting duplicates, or filtering voids before revision selection.
Rounding each duration share independently; dropping retained lines instead of zeroing them.
not_blocked: Every input needed is supplied offline; the rules are complete and the reference implementation plus an independent oracle agree on the customer history and 20 nearby scenarios.
